description:
Daily price history

One fund's daily price, shares, investors and size between `start` and `end` (inclusive; default the 30 days up to its latest price; at most 1,830 days per request), oldest first, with `meta.changePercent` over the range. History since October 2021. Use for a fund's price history or its change over a period.

GET /v1/funds/{code}/prices on Turkish funds (SBX-FON). Costs 1 credit per call.

code.description: A TEFAS fund code, e.g. AAL.

end.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the fund's latest price date.

name: funds_getFundPrices
title: Turkish funds: Daily price history
